options.label: CPU model
options.help: CPU model. 68020+ are 32-bit; 68040/68060 include FPU and MMU. Higher models are faster.

options.label: 24-bit addressing
options.help: Essential for A500/A1200 compatibility. Disable for Z3 RAM usage.
options.constraint: 24-bit addressing is not available on a 68040 or 68060, with the JIT, or with a 32-bit accelerator board.

options.label: More compatible
options.help: Approximates prefetch pipeline of 68000/010. Required for some timing sensitive games.
options.constraint: More compatible is always on in cycle-exact modes and always off for a 68040 or 68060 with the JIT.

options.label: No unimplemented CPU emulation
options.help: Do not emulate the 68060 instructions the CPU traps as unimplemented.
options.constraint: Only on a 68060; unimplemented instruction emulation is always on with the JIT.

options.label: Data cache emulation
options.help: Emulate the CPU data cache. Required for some 68030+ software.
options.constraint: Data cache emulation needs a 68030 or later in More compatible mode, without the JIT, and the indirect UAE Boot ROM.

options.label: MMU
options.help: Full MMU emulation is required for some operating systems; EC models have no MMU.
options.constraint: MMU emulation needs a 68030 or later and is not available with the JIT.

options.label: FPU
options.help: Floating point unit. A 68040 or 68060 uses its internal FPU.
options.constraint: A 68000 or 68010 in More compatible or cycle-exact mode has no FPU, and a 68040 or 68060 uses its internal FPU.

options.label: More compatible FPU
options.help: More accurate but slower FPU emulation.
options.constraint: Needs an FPU.

options.label: Softfloat FPU (80-bit)
options.help: FPU precision mode. Softfloat is most accurate but slowest; the JIT FPU replaces it.
options.constraint: Needs an FPU.

options.label: No unimplemented FPU emulation
options.help: Do not emulate the FPU instructions the CPU traps as unimplemented.
options.constraint: Not available without an FPU, nor with the JIT, which always emulates them.

options.label: CPU speed
options.help: Fastest possible runs the CPU as fast as the host allows; the other mode matches original Amiga speed.

options.label: CPU speed adjustment
options.help: Makes the CPU slower or faster than the selected speed, from -90% to +500%; 0 keeps it as it is.
options.constraint: Not available in full cycle-exact mode.

options.label: CPU idle
options.help: How much the host CPU sleeps while the emulated CPU waits; 0 disables it.
options.constraint: Not available at the approximate (real) CPU speed.

options.label: CPU frequency
options.help: CPU clock as a multiple of the chipset clock in More compatible and cycle-exact modes.
options.constraint: Needs More compatible or cycle-exact mode, and not the fastest speed.

options.label: Multi-threaded CPU
options.help: Run CPU emulation on a separate thread. Experimental. May help CPU-heavy software, but hardware-register accesses require synchronization and can make it slower.
options.constraint: The CPU thread needs a 68020 or later and is not available with PPC emulation, More compatible, cycle-exact or MMU modes.

options.label: PPC CPU emulation
options.help: Enable PowerPC CPU emulation for CyberStorm PPC or Blizzard PPC boards.

options.label: JIT cache size
options.help: Just-In-Time compilation cache; 0 turns the JIT off. Greatly speeds up CPU emulation but reduces compatibility.
options.constraint: The JIT needs a 68020 or later with 32-bit addressing and no MMU, and at least 128 KB. Turning it on leaves cycle-exact modes.

options.label: JIT FPU support
options.help: Enable JIT compilation for FPU instructions.
options.constraint: Needs the JIT and an FPU.

options.label: Constant jump
options.help: JIT compilation optimization.
options.constraint: Needs the JIT, which needs a 68020 or later with 32-bit addressing and no MMU.

options.label: Cache flush mode
options.help: Hard flushes the JIT cache on every resize/reset.
options.constraint: Needs the JIT, which needs a 68020 or later with 32-bit addressing and no MMU.

options.label: No flags
options.help: Don't update status flags (faster but less compatible).
options.constraint: Needs the JIT, which needs a 68020 or later with 32-bit addressing and no MMU.

options.label: Catch exceptions
options.help: Catch memory access faults in compiled code.
options.constraint: Needs the JIT, which needs a 68020 or later with 32-bit addressing and no MMU.

options.label: Memory access
options.help: Direct memory access is faster; indirect is slower but more compatible.
options.constraint: Needs the JIT, which needs a 68020 or later with 32-bit addressing and no MMU.

options.label: Chipset
options.help: Original Chip Set (A500/A1000/A2000), Enhanced Chip Set (A600/A3000) or AGA (A1200/A4000).

options.label: NTSC
options.help: NTSC video mode (60 Hz) instead of PAL (50 Hz). Also moves the output refresh rate.

options.label: Cycle exactness
options.help: Bit-perfect CPU and DMA timing. Full needs a fast host; DMA/Memory only covers chipset accesses.

options.label: Immediate Blitter
options.help: Blitter operations complete instantly. Faster but less accurate.

options.label: Wait for Blitter
options.help: CPU waits for the Blitter to finish. More compatible than Immediate Blitter.
options.constraint: Not available with immediate blits, nor in the cycle-exact modes on a 68000 or 68010.

options.label: Keyboard layout
options.help: Keyboard controller emulation mode.

options.label: Keyboard N-key rollover
options.help: Allow multiple simultaneous key presses.
options.constraint: The UAE and Cherry (A2000 8039) keyboard controllers have no N-key rollover.

options.label: Optimizations
options.help: Chipset drawing optimizations. Keep at Full for best compatibility.

options.label: Collision level
options.help: Sprite and playfield collision detection. Full is the most compatible.

options.label: Chipset extra
options.help: Machine-specific chipset behaviour. Selecting one rewrites the advanced chipset options.

options.label: Monitor sync source
options.help: Video port sync signal layout for special monitors.

options.label: Genlock connected
options.help: Connect a genlock device for video overlay mixing.

options.label: Genlock source
options.help: What the genlock overlays on the Amiga video signal. The video and LaserDisc sources need a VIDEOGRAB build.
options.constraint: Needs genlock on.

options.label: Genlock mix
options.help: Weight (of 256) of the Amiga picture where the genlock source shows through: 0 shows the source alone; each step of 25 blends in about 10% more of the Amiga picture.
options.constraint: Needs genlock on.

options.label: Include alpha channels
options.help: Include alpha channels in screenshots and video captures.
options.constraint: Needs genlock on.

options.label: Keep aspect ratio
options.help: Keep the genlock source aspect ratio.
options.constraint: Needs genlock on.

options.label: Battery backed up real time clock
options.help: Real-time clock chip.
options.constraint: With a chipset extra active, only the RTC chip of the selected machine survives the configuration checks.

options.label: RTC adjustment
options.help: Real-time clock adjustment in seconds.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CIA-A TOD clock source
options.help: Time-of-day clock source: vertical blank or power line frequency.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CIA ROM overlay
options.help: Enable CIA-based Kickstart ROM overlay mechanism.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: A1000 Boot RAM/ROM
options.help: Enable A1000-style boot RAM at $C00000.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: DF0: ID hardware
options.help: Enable DF0 drive ID hardware detection.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CD32 CD
options.help: Enable CD32 CD-ROM drive.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CD32 C2P
options.help: Enable CD32 chunky-to-planar hardware acceleration.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CD32 NVRAM
options.help: Enable CD32 non-volatile RAM for saved data.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CDTV CD
options.help: Enable CDTV CD-ROM drive.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CDTV SRAM
options.help: Enable CDTV static RAM for saved data.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CDTV-CR
options.help: Enable CDTV card reader.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: ROM mirror (E0)
options.help: Enable Kickstart ROM mirror at $E00000.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: ROM mirror (A8)
options.help: Enable Kickstart ROM mirror at $A80000.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Composite color burst
options.help: Enable color burst signal on composite video output.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Keyboard reset warning
options.help: Show warning when keyboard reset is pressed.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CIA TOD bug
options.help: Emulate CIA Time of Day hardware bug.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Custom register byte write bug
options.help: Emulate byte write bug in custom chip registers.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Power up memory pattern
options.help: Fill memory with pattern on power-up like real hardware.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Kickstart ROM has Chip RAM speed
options.help: Kickstart ROM runs at Chip RAM speed instead of faster.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Toshiba Gary
options.help: Use Toshiba Gary instead of Commodore Gary.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Z3 Autoconfig
options.help: Enable Zorro III AutoConfig for expansion boards.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: PCMCIA
options.help: Enable the PCMCIA slot (A600/A1200).
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: 1 MB Chip / 0.5 MB + 0.5 MB
options.help: Jumper for 1MB chip RAM or 512KB+512KB configuration.
options.constraint: Only available with less than 1 MB chip RAM; the core fixes it on above that.

options.label: CIA revision
options.help: Use the newer CIA chip revision 391078-01 in both sockets.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: IDE controller
options.help: Built-in IDE controller type. The A600/A1200 and A4000 controllers exclude each other, as on real hardware.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: A3000 WD33C93 SCSI
options.help: Enable the A3000 built-in WD33C93 SCSI controller.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: A4000T NCR53C710 SCSI
options.help: Enable the A4000T built-in NCR53C710 SCSI controller.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Unmapped address space
options.help: What unmapped memory reads return.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: CIA E-clock sync
options.help: CIA E-Clock synchronization method.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Ramsey revision
options.help: Ramsey memory controller revision (hexadecimal); -1 disables the revision override.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Fat Gary revision
options.help: Fat Gary chip revision (hexadecimal); -1 disables the revision override.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Agnus/Alice revision
options.help: Agnus/Alice chip revision (hexadecimal); -1 disables the revision override.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Denise/Lisa revision
options.help: Denise/Lisa chip revision (hexadecimal); -1 disables the revision override.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Agnus/Alice model
options.help: Agnus/Alice chip model variant.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Agnus/Alice size
options.help: Agnus/Alice addressable memory size.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Denise/Lisa model
options.help: Denise/Lisa chip model variant.
options.constraint: Not available while a chipset extra is set; the extra sets it.

options.label: Chip RAM
options.help: Main memory accessible by all custom chips. A500 had 512 KB, A1200 2 MB; more than 512 KB requires ECS Agnus.
options.constraint: More than 2 MB excludes Zorro II fast RAM and Zorro II RTG boards; 1.5 MB is not available with the JIT.

options.label: Slow RAM
options.help: 512 KB expansion in the A500/A2000 trapdoor slot (Ranger RAM): accessible by custom chips but slower.
options.constraint: 1.8 MB conflicts with Gayle, Gary or Ramsey; 1.5 MB is not available with the JIT.

options.label: Z2 Fast RAM
options.help: Zorro II expansion memory. 16-bit, not accessible by custom chips, max 8 MB.
options.constraint: More than 256 KB excludes chip RAM above 2 MB.

options.label: Z2 Fast RAM below 1 MB
options.help: Zorro II fast RAM below 1 MB (written as fastmem_size_k). 0 clears a sub-1 MB board.
options.constraint: Boards below 1 MB must be 64, 128, 256 or 512 KB.

options.label: Z2 Fast RAM board 2
options.help: Second Zorro II fast RAM board.

options.label: Z2 Fast RAM board 2 below 1 MB
options.help: Second Zorro II fast RAM board below 1 MB.
options.constraint: Boards below 1 MB must be 64, 128, 256 or 512 KB.

options.label: Z2 Fast RAM board 3
options.help: Third Zorro II fast RAM board.

options.label: Z2 Fast RAM board 3 below 1 MB
options.help: Third Zorro II fast RAM board below 1 MB.
options.constraint: Boards below 1 MB must be 64, 128, 256 or 512 KB.

options.label: Z2 Fast RAM board 4
options.help: Fourth Zorro II fast RAM board.

options.label: Z2 Fast RAM board 4 below 1 MB
options.help: Fourth Zorro II fast RAM board below 1 MB.
options.constraint: Boards below 1 MB must be 64, 128, 256 or 512 KB.

options.label: Z3 Fast RAM
options.help: Zorro III expansion memory. 32-bit, used with 68030+ CPUs; not accessible by custom chips.
options.constraint: Needs 32-bit addressing, and is limited by the reserved Zorro III window.

options.label: Z3 Fast RAM board 2
options.help: Second Zorro III fast RAM board.
options.constraint: Needs 32-bit addressing, and is limited by the reserved Zorro III window.

options.label: Z3 Fast RAM board 3
options.help: Third Zorro III fast RAM board.
options.constraint: Needs 32-bit addressing, and is limited by the reserved Zorro III window.

options.label: Z3 Fast RAM board 4
options.help: Fourth Zorro III fast RAM board.
options.constraint: Needs 32-bit addressing, and is limited by the reserved Zorro III window.

options.label: Motherboard Fast RAM
options.help: Fast RAM on the A3000/A4000 motherboard. Not accessible by custom chips.
options.constraint: Up to 64 MB, aligned to MB.

options.label: Processor slot Fast RAM
options.help: Fast RAM on a CPU accelerator card in the processor slot. Not accessible by custom chips.
options.constraint: Up to 128 MB, aligned to MB.

options.label: 32-bit Chip RAM
options.help: Extended chip RAM accessible by custom chips. Requires 32-bit addressing.
options.constraint: Needs 32-bit addressing, and is limited by the reserved Zorro III window.

options.label: Z3 mapping mode
options.help: Z3 memory address mapping. Automatic picks the best layout, UAE and Real match those address spaces.
options.constraint: Needs 32-bit addressing.

options.label: Main ROM file
options.help: Kickstart ROM image. The default configuration picks the first suitable installed ROM.

options.label: Extended ROM file
options.help: Extended ROM image (CD32/CDTV extension or Arcadia bios).

options.label: UAE boot ROM
options.help: UAE boot ROM type. Automatic uses the FS + F0 ROM when software needs it.

options.label: UAE expansion board
options.help: UAE expansion board (needs the UAE boot ROM), for software that requires it.
options.constraint: The board rewires expansion hardware, so it can only change while the emulator is stopped.

choices.label: New UAE (64k + F0 ROM), no diagnostics ROM
New UAE (128k, ROM, Direct), no diagnostics ROM
New UAE (128k, ROM, Indirect), no diagnostics ROM

options.label: Flash RAM file
options.help: Flash RAM or A2286/A2386SX BIOS CMOS RAM save file.

options.label: ShapeShifter support
options.help: Enable support for the ShapeShifter Mac emulator.

options.label: Native vertical sync
options.help: Standard waits for vertical blank, 50/60Hz enforces the emulated refresh rate.
options.constraint: Not available under KMSDRM, which paces with the console driver.

options.label: Blacker than black
options.help: Enable proper black levels for displays that support it.

options.label: Remove interlace artifacts
options.help: Apply scanline doubling to reduce the flicker of interlaced video modes.

options.label: Monochrome video out
options.help: Render the display in grayscale, simulating a monochrome monitor.

options.label: Filtered low resolution
options.help: Apply filtering to low resolution modes for a smoother appearance.

options.label: VGA mode resolution autoswitch
options.help: Switch the render resolution for VGA modes when they are detected.
options.constraint: Needs HighRes and Double line mode, the only modes where it can trigger.

options.label: Display resync blanking
options.help: Blank the screen for this long after a display mode change.

options.label: Amiga resolution
options.help: Internal render resolution relative to the Amiga's video output.
options.constraint: Not available while resolution autoswitch follows the Amiga's screen mode.

options.label: Overscan
options.help: Amount of border area to display around the Amiga picture.

options.label: Resolution autoswitch
options.help: Follow the Amiga's current screen mode; the percentages are the share of the frame that must switch before the render resolution changes.

options.label: Brightness
options.help: Brightness adjustment from -200 to +200; 0 leaves the picture as it is.

options.label: Contrast
options.help: Contrast adjustment from -200 to +200; 0 leaves the picture as it is.

options.label: Gamma
options.help: Gamma adjustment from -200 to +200; 0 leaves the picture as it is.

options.label: Gamma red
options.help: Red channel gamma adjustment from -200 to +200; 0 leaves it as it is.

options.label: Gamma green
options.help: Green channel gamma adjustment from -200 to +200; 0 leaves it as it is.

options.label: Gamma blue
options.help: Blue channel gamma adjustment from -200 to +200; 0 leaves it as it is.

options.label: Dark palette fix
options.help: Convert 3-bit color palettes so dark shades stay distinguishable.

options.label: Horizontal centering
options.help: Center the display horizontally; Smart follows the picture.
options.constraint: Not available with auto crop, nor above the Overscan border setting, which uses the whole area.

options.label: Vertical centering
options.help: Center the display vertically; Smart follows the picture.
options.constraint: Not available with auto crop, nor above the Overscan border setting, which uses the whole area.

options.label: Correct aspect ratio
options.help: Apply Amiga display aspect correction to native modes.
options.constraint: Not available with the Stretch scaling method.

options.label: Always stretch PAL as NTSC
options.help: Show PAL modes with NTSC vertical proportions. The bottom of the PAL display is cut.

options.label: Scaling method
options.help: How the display is scaled to fit the window.

options.label: Line mode
options.help: Line doubling and scanline effects for progressive and interlaced modes.
options.constraint: Not available while resolution autoswitch follows the Amiga's screen mode.

options.label: Sound emulation
options.help: None turns all sound off; Emulated keeps Paula timing without output; Exact is most accurate.
options.constraint: Cycle-exact modes need at least emulated sound, so Disabled is not available in them.

options.label: Automatic switching
options.help: Automatically adjust the sound emulation quality based on performance.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Master volume
options.help: Master output volume; 100% is full volume and 0% silent.

options.label: Paula volume
options.help: Paula (Amiga sound chip) volume; 100% is full volume.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: CD volume
options.help: CD audio volume; 100% is full volume.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: AHI volume
options.help: Retargetable (AHI) audio volume; 100% is full volume.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: MIDI volume
options.help: MIDI volume; 100% is full volume.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Channel mode
options.help: Stereo, multi-channel and cloned-stereo output modes.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Stereo separation
options.help: How far apart the left and right channels are; 0% is mono.
options.constraint: Needs a stereo (or multi-channel) output mode.

options.label: Interpolation
options.help: Resampling filter between Paula and the output device.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Frequency
options.help: Output sample rate; 44100 or 48000 is recommended for modern systems.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Swap Paula channels

options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Swap AHI channels

options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Stereo delay
options.help: Delay between the stereo channels for a wider soundstage; 0 disables it.
options.constraint: Needs a stereo (or multi-channel) output mode.

options.label: Audio filter

options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Audio filter type

options.help: Input device for joyport 1, the mouse port.

options.help: Input device for joyport 2, the joystick port.

options.help: Autofire for the Port 2 device.

options.help: Emulation mode of the Port 1 device.

options.label: Layout

options.label: Toggle button

options.constraint: Needs the drive enabled.

options.label: DF0: drive type
options.help: Drive type of DF0:, or Disabled. AmigaOS sees a change after a reset.
options.constraint: FloppyBridge needs a build with FloppyBridge support.

options.label: DF1: image
options.help: Disk image in drive DF1:, or empty for no disk.
options.constraint: Needs the drive enabled.

options.label: DF1: drive type
options.help: Drive type of DF1:, or Disabled. AmigaOS sees a change after a reset.
options.constraint: FloppyBridge needs a build with FloppyBridge support.

options.label: DF2: image
options.help: Disk image in drive DF2:, or empty for no disk.
options.constraint: Needs the drive enabled.

options.label: DF2: drive type
options.help: Drive type of DF2:, or Disabled. AmigaOS sees a change after a reset.
options.constraint: FloppyBridge needs a build with FloppyBridge support.

options.label: DF3: image
options.help: Disk image in drive DF3:, or empty for no disk.
options.constraint: Needs the drive enabled.

options.label: DF3: drive type
options.help: Drive type of DF3:, or Disabled. AmigaOS sees a change after a reset.
options.constraint: FloppyBridge needs a build with FloppyBridge support.

options.label: Floppy drive emulation speed
options.help: Drive speed in percent of a real drive; Turbo transfers without delays.

options.label: CD drive
options.help: The CD drive's image or host drive, then optional fields (,image ,ioctl ,delay:). Empty for no CD drive, "empty" for a drive without a disc.
options.constraint: A change of disc or host drive applies at once; the startup delay (delay:) when the emulation starts.

options.label: CD speed
options.help: Normal CD drive speed, or Turbo to read without the drive's delays.
options.constraint: The running emulation keeps the speed it started with.

options.label: Create .uaem metadata files
options.help: Store Amiga file attributes and comments in .uaem files next to the host files.

options.label: Disable UAEFSDB
options.help: Do not keep the Amiga file attributes the host filesystem cannot store.
options.constraint: Only while the emulation is stopped.

options.label: Show GUI on startup
options.help: Show the settings when Amiberry starts, before the emulation runs.

options.label: Synchronize clock
options.help: Keep the Amiga's clock in step with the host's time.

options.label: One second reboot pause
options.help: Pause for one second when the Amiga resets.

options.label: Clipboard sharing
options.help: Share the clipboard between the Amiga and the host.

options.label: Native on-screen display
options.help: Show the status line with the drive and power LEDs on the native Amiga display.

options.label: RTG on-screen display
options.help: Show the status line with the drive and power LEDs on the RTG display.

options.label: Log illegal memory accesses
options.help: Log reads and writes to addresses where no memory is.

options.label: Master floppy write protection
options.help: Write-protect every floppy disk image.

options.label: Master hard drive write protection
options.help: Write-protect every hard drive.

options.label: Hide all UAE autoconfig boards
options.help: Hide the emulator's own expansion boards from the Amiga's autoconfig.

options.label: Right Ctrl as Right Amiga
options.help: Use the right Control key as the right Amiga key.

options.label: Power LED when the audio filter is off
options.help: Show the power LED at half brightness while the audio filter is off, as on an A500.

options.label: Debug memory space
options.help: Add a memory space for debugging tools.

options.label: Force hard reset if CPU halted
options.help: Hard-reset the Amiga when its CPU halts.

options.label: A600/A1200/A4000 IDE scsi.device disable
options.help: Disable the scsi.device of the built-in IDE controller on these models.

options.label: Warp mode reset
options.help: Run at warp speed while the Amiga boots after a reset.

options.label: Use RetroArch quit button
options.help: Quit with the controller's RetroArch quit button combination.

options.label: Use RetroArch menu button
options.help: Open the settings with the controller's RetroArch menu button combination.

options.label: Use RetroArch reset button
options.help: Reset with the controller's RetroArch reset button combination.

options.label: RTG board memory
options.help: Video memory of the RTG graphics board; None removes the board.
options.constraint: Sizes outside the board's range are not available, nor any while no board fits the machine.

options.label: RTG board
options.help: The RTG graphics board: the UAE board AmigaOS drives through Picasso96, or an emulated card.
options.constraint: Zorro III boards need 32-bit addressing; Zorro II boards, at most 2 MB chip RAM.

options.label: Hardware sprite emulation
options.help: Show the mouse pointer as the UAE board's hardware sprite.
options.constraint: Only the UAE RTG board has it.

options.label: Accelerator board
options.help: A CPU accelerator board: a faster CPU, often with its own memory, SCSI controller or boot ROM.
options.constraint: PPC boards need an emulator built with PPC support.

options.label: Accelerator jumpers
options.help: The board's jumpers that are on, as the configuration writes them.
options.constraint: Only on boards with jumpers.

options.label: Accelerator memory
options.help: Memory on the accelerator board.
options.constraint: Only on boards with memory, up to the most the board takes.

options.label: bsdsocket.library
options.help: TCP/IP networking for Amiga programs through the host's network.

options.label: uaescsi.device
options.help: Amiga access to host and emulated CD drives through uaescsi.device.
options.constraint: Stays on while host CD drives are mapped (Map CD drives).

options.label: Auto crop
options.help: Crop the borders by scanning what the picture shows.
options.constraint: Not together with manual crop.

options.label: Manual crop
options.help: Show a window of the picture you set (size and position).
options.constraint: Not together with auto crop.

options.label: Crop width
options.help: The width of the window, in pixels at the render resolution; at most the whole frame.
options.constraint: Only with manual crop.

options.label: Crop height
options.help: The height of the window, in pixels at the render resolution; at most the whole frame.
options.constraint: Only with manual crop.

options.label: Horizontal offset
options.help: Moves the window left or right.
options.constraint: Only with manual crop.

options.label: Vertical offset
options.help: Moves the window up or down.
options.constraint: Only with manual crop.

options.label: Native screen shader
options.help: The shader the native Amiga screen modes are shown through: a built-in CRT shader or a preset from the shaders folder.

options.label: Built-in CRT bezel
options.help: A television frame around the picture (with the built-in CRT shaders).
options.constraint: Not together with a custom bezel.

options.label: Protection dongle
options.help: The copy protection dongle a game checks for.
